items.stem: A blog claims ice cream sales 'cause' drowning deaths because both rise in summer. What is the best critique?
options: The sample size is always too small
A confounding variable (season/weather) explains both trends
Correlation always implies causation in seasonal data
The chart must use a pie graph instead

items.stem: Before sharing a survey result internally, which quality check comes first?
options: Pick the most dramatic chart type
Confirm who was sampled and whether they represent the decision audience
Remove all outliers regardless of context
Add more decimal places for precision

blueprints.title: Capstone data story
blueprints.projectPrompt: Using the provided retail returns dataset, produce a one-page brief for operations leadership: one headline insight, two supporting visuals, and a recommended action with caveats about data limitations.
